items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: you also went back to France in 1953, where you played with Francois Moustache Galapadis.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Okay. Although you were with Lester Lanin for a while, you also went back to France in 1953, where you played with Francois Moustache Galapadis.

Let's see, I'm trying to recall what -- this was long before I went with Lanin. Things are going so fast right now. I did go back right after -- Oh, yes, I came back from the Festival of Jazz in Paris and I was invited by Mezz Mezzrow along with Red Richards, Kansas Fields, Gene Sedric, Buck Clayton -- all of us got a contract to go back to Paris for a tour in Europe. It was Mezz Mezzrow's project and we rehearsed and we played many of the principal cities and Paris and then we went to . . .
